# Meme

Meme generator: original meme images about any situation, generated with your top and bottom captions spelled out.

## What it does
Describe the joke and the captions. Claude tells you the price and creates the image.

**How the files are made:** each meme is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Original images only; no real people's faces.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install meme@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Meme talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/meme/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each meme uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The memes show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_meme_models` | Models for memes with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_meme_cost` | Exact price of one meme before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_meme` | Starts one meme in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_meme` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A cat staring at a laptop: top 'Monday meeting', bottom 'could have been an email'"
- "A dog in a firefighter hat: 'Me fixing bugs in production'"
- "A wizard reading a scroll: 'Reading the release notes'"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the meme (the idea and the captions) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
